# Daily Report — 2026-07-28

## Task Completed
Added `get_workflow_activity` tool (GET sys_hub_action_type_base/{sys_id}). Accepts a
sys_id (32-char hex passthrough) or an exact action type name (resolved via a
name= table lookup). Returns a normalised activity record with `sys_id`, `name`,
`label`, `description`, `category`, `active`, `scope`, `created_on`,
`updated_on`, and `created_by` fields. Includes 404 and empty-result guards.
Registered in `platform_developer` and `full` packages alongside the existing
`list_workflow_activities` tool.
